Collectible Cards: All 18 Sets (480 Cards) — GTA 6 guide

Confirmed by multiple launch guides · not personally verified All five counties of Leonida

Hundreds of trading cards are tucked onto tables, counters and noticeboards all over Leonida — and pawn shops pay real money for the rare ones.

Full guide — contains spoilers

There are 480 collectible cards across 18 themed sets of 12 to 36 cards (Backyard Wrestling is the 12-card set). Duplicates exist — the same card appears in multiple spots — and duplicates can be sold, so 480 is a set-completion total rather than 480 unique cards — baseball, basketball, football, soccer, wrestling, comics and dancers, including the Vice City Flamingos, Vice City Narcos and Los Santos Pounders. Cards sit at fixed spots on tables, dressers, counters, walls, yellow phone boxes and toolboxes; some hide in safes and locked buildings. From Chapter 2 you can sell them at pawn shops, typically from about $20 up to $1,000 or more for the rarest (PowerPyx's range; KeenGamer/ShowGamer location tables claim individual special cards at $4,800–$6,000 — single-source figures), and selling never erases your collection progress — unsold cards can be viewed in the wooden box at your residence. Completing any 3 sets earns the 'Don't Touch My Deck' trophy; 100% completion requires 15 of the 18 sets (at least 372 cards).

Source & evidence

Source: All Collectible Cards in GTA 6 - Locations, Sets, Prices, and Rewards — KeenGamer.

Evidence: Set list, selling rules and rewards; totals confirmed post-launch by PowerPyx, gta.guide and HeistAtlas. 480 cards / 18 sets confirmed by PowerPyx, KeenGamer, gta.guide and HeistAtlas, including the full set list. Sale range ~$20–$1,000+ per PowerPyx; higher per-card figures ($4,800–$6,000) are single-source. One single-source cluster reports two Starlet Motel cards disappear once Chapter 2 ends, while PowerPyx states nothing for 100% is missable — both claims recorded (see the Chapter 2 guide).
